note: The issue's second measurable claim: 'fails with a validation error if you do [write pos.w]'. This is the user-visible consequence of the missing pass-through -- the DXIL validator rejects a module that leaves declared output components unwritten. Tracked as a SEPARATE predicate from match.json rather than folded into it, because the two can in principle come apart: narrowing the output signature mask to .w would silence the validator while leaving the shader's x/y/z output undefined, which is still the reported bug. Kept element-name-agnostic ('Not all elements of ... were written') because the validator's exact phrasing is not guaranteed stable across releases; ground truth at ab5400907 emits both 'Not all elements of output SV_Position were written.' and 'Not all elements of SV_Position were written.'. Positive-only, so it is not satisfiable by a compile that produced nothing. CONTROLS: the same two controls used for match.json score no-match under this predicate too (variant-control-untouched--match-validation-main-debug.txt and variant-control-all-components--match-validation-main-debug.txt), confirming it does not fire on a shader that compiles clean.
